minutes.headline: Committee will hold the architect's final report two weeks for review before posting it
minutes.summary: The committee discussed the architect's large final report and agreed to give members about two weeks to review it before posting it publicly. It heard that a comparative new-building cost estimate is due from the architect by next week, and planned the spring town meeting update article and the funding article for added design work. Minutes for two prior meetings were approved and the meeting adjourned.
